title: I made a 3D 2048 you can play in your browser — feedback welcome!
author: niksiniksin

comments.author: niksiniksin
comments.body:
I made this game entirely with AI and i don't a see a problem in it. I've seen people talking about Ai Slop destroying videogame community. I think that SLOP is a problem, but not Ai itself. Slop existed way before any Ai even before any computers. 

It is your choices that define quality.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/niksiniksin this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development, so please add some. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process, not only the finished game. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: niksiniksin
replies.body: Sure! Added detail on how i made this game with Ai. Didn't mean to break any rules and happy to contribute to your sub with my experience.
